spec: Implement the user-supplied requirements at https://github.com/contoso/ledger-service/issues/55. Source revision: 2026-09-21T13:15:00Z. Task acceptance criteria below map that scope to specialist-owned work.

tasks.title: Add balances to ledger-core
tasks.body:
Add a `Balance` record, a sealed `BalanceResult` (found or unknown account) and a `BalanceQuery` port to `ledger-core`, and `LedgerService.balance(account)`.

## Acceptance criteria
- The balance is debits minus credits with scale 2 and `RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN`.
- An account with no postings gives the unknown result.
- Unit tests cover both results.

tasks.title: Query balances in PostgreSQL
tasks.body:
Implement `BalanceQuery` in `JdbcLedgerRepository` with one aggregate query over `posting`.

## Acceptance criteria
- `JdbcLedgerRepositoryIT` covers mixed debits and credits and an unknown account.
- No migration file changes.

tasks.title: Serve GET /accounts/{account}/balance
tasks.body:
Add `AccountBalanceHandler` to `ledger-app` and register it next to `/journals`.

## Acceptance criteria
- A known account returns 200 with the account and the balance as a string with scale 2.
- An unknown account returns 404.
- `/journals` responses are unchanged.
